Report Claims Russian Oligarch Funded Trump Jr.'s Bahamas Wedding

A report claims that a Russian oligarch, described as close to Vladimir Putin, secretly funded Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding in the Bahamas. The report alleges that Umar Kremlev, identified as the head of the International Boxing Association and connected to the Kremlin, funneled money for the rental of a private island for the event. Donald Trump reportedly did not attend the wedding.
